title: Seedream and Seedance get new engines
summary:
Seedream and Seedance got model upgrades, chat requests got more selective, and three community projects joined the showcase.

`seedream` moved to 4.5, with a 2048-pixel default side length and support for up to 14 reference images. `seedance` moved from separate Lite models to one Pro-Fast model for text-to-video and image-to-video. Related fixes let reference images work when their host sends an unhelpful file type, scale small Seedream requests to the model’s minimum, and fall back to Seedream 4.0 on rate-limit or server errors.

Chat now sends thinking settings only to Claude models and omits the default `top_p` value, avoiding parameter combinations some Bedrock models reject. Its video generation requests also use the image API base URL.

The sign-in page now shows pricing, while the Pollen balance panel explains that purchases can take 1–2 minutes to appear. Video pricing and model tooltips identify the video API as alpha, and the Featured App tier links to the app-submission form.
